starts.note: customer: start only when the customer says one or more debit cards were declined with CODE 05 (Do Not Honor) or a generic decline. Check one card at a time, starting with the card the customer picks. Each fix is made only when its check finds that cause, and only after the customer says yes. That covers unfreezing, clearing a customer-initiated fraud alert after every transaction is confirmed, and lifting a velocity block. The agent only offers a dispute when the customer denies a transaction. A bank-initiated alert is transferred to security without an offer, because the document says to.
starts.quote: If status is FROZEN → Ask customer if they want to unfreeze. If yes, follow the freezing/unfreezing card protocol.

tools.not_used: Used only for a PENDING card. branch_pending hands that card to activating_a_debit_card, which picks the tool by issue_reason.
Used only for a PENDING replacement card. It is handed to activating_a_debit_card.
Used only for a PENDING reissued card. It is handed to activating_a_debit_card.
A replacement for a CLOSED card, or after a fraud closure, is ordered in order_replacement_debit_card.
A transaction the customer denies during the alert review is disputed in filing_a_debit_card_transaction_dispute (go_to_dispute).
A card is closed after a fraud dispute in closing_cancelling_a_debit_card, never in this job.

steps.do: Once the fraud dispute is filed, the card's action comes from the dispute's category (close_and_reissue for a fraud category). Hand the card to closing_cancelling_a_debit_card, and then to order_replacement_debit_card if the customer wants a new card. Never clear the alert on a card with a denied transaction. Tell the customer the old card will not work again and a replacement is on its way.
steps.if: the customer denied a transaction and a dispute was filed for it
steps.quote: This parameter records metadata only; the agent must separately perform the indicated card action after filing the dispute.

steps.do: Check velocity_blocked. If it is TRUE, read the scripted velocity message, ask whether to lift the block now, and ask about the recent activity
steps.if: velocity_blocked is TRUE (check this even on a card that was just unfrozen)
steps.quote: If velocity_blocked is TRUE, inform customer: 'Your card was temporarily blocked because our security system detected unusual activity patterns. This block automatically lifts after 30 minutes. Would you like me to verify your identity and lift it now?'

steps.do: If the customer does not want the block lifted now, tell them it lifts by itself after 30 minutes. Do not clear it.
steps.if: velocity_blocked is TRUE and the customer declines the early lift
steps.quote: Velocity blocks automatically expire after 30 minutes, but can be cleared earlier by a customer service agent after identity verification.

steps.do: Clear the velocity block
steps.if: the customer wants the block lifted and gives a reasonable explanation (unlock clear_debit_card_fraud_alert_4892 first)
steps.quote: For velocity blocks: Customer provides a reasonable explanation for the unusual activity (e.g., shopping spree, travel)

steps.do: Do not lift the block. Tell the customer the activity needs review by the security team, ask whether they want to be transferred, and transfer only if they say yes.

rules.rule: Never clear a bank-initiated fraud alert. Transfer to the security team instead.
rules.quote: Bank-Initiated Alerts**: Placed by Rho-Bank's fraud detection systems when high-risk patterns are identified. These CANNOT be cleared by customer service agents and require review by the security team.

rules.rule: Clear a customer-initiated fraud alert only if the customer confirms that all recent transactions are legitimate.
rules.quote: If they confirm all transactions are legitimate, clear the alert.

rules.rule: Use reason 'customer_verified' to clear a fraud alert and reason 'velocity_clear' to clear a velocity block.
rules.quote: Use this tool to clear fraud alerts or velocity blocks on a customer's debit card.

rules.rule: Account tiers: Entry is Light Blue, Light Green and Green Fee-Free. Mid is Blue and Green (checking). Premium is Evergreen. Elite is Bluest.
A velocity block lifts by itself after 30 minutes. It may be lifted earlier after verification.
rules.quote: Velocity blocks automatically expire after 30 minutes, but can be cleared earlier by a customer service agent after identity verification.

rules.rule: A CLOSED card cannot be used. Point the customer to another active card, or offer a replacement.
rules.quote: If status is CLOSED → Inform customer this card is no longer active. Check if they have another active card or offer to order a replacement.

rules.quote: DO NOT provide specific details if status is SUSPENDED or RESTRICTED.

done_when: Every declined card has been checked in order (status, account, fraud alert, velocity block). Each issue found has been resolved or routed: frozen cards unfrozen if the customer wanted (and still checked for an alert and a velocity block), velocity blocks cleared after an explanation, and customer-initiated alerts cleared only when all transactions are confirmed, otherwise sent to the dispute job, after which the card was closed and a replacement offered. Bank-initiated alerts have been transferred. CLOSED and PENDING cards have been explained and routed.
